subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Types of Identity Theft
description: A micro-lesson that makes Types of Identity Theft usable.

hook.text: Identity theft isn't one crime. It's a family of crimes, each targeting different parts of your life.

buildup.text: Financial identity theft uses your info to open accounts or make purchases.

discovery.text: Medical identity theft uses your insurance to get treatment. You inherit someone else's health records.

twist.text: Criminal identity theft means someone gives police your name when arrested. You get the warrant.

climax.text: Child identity theft targets minors whose clean records go unmonitored for years.

punchline.text: Thieves don't just steal money — they steal lives.

quiz.question: What is medical identity theft?
options: Using someone's insurance to receive treatment
